from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-89bd6914.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        # Find maximal diagonal runs of a single non-background color.
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                # Continue the line out from both ends, stopping at an obstacle or edge.
                for (er, ec), sr, sc in ((run[0], -dr, -dc), (run[-1], dr, dc)):
                    rr, cc = er + sr, ec + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
